attacks.expected_effect: Unchecked distribution statistics leak test set properties into training fold transformations
attacks.control: Invariant 2.1: Preprocessing fit scope strictly confined to training fold slices; unfit pipeline templates before CV

attacks.expected_effect: Selection bias artificially deflates CV error by choosing features correlated with validation/test targets
attacks.control: Invariant 2.2: Feature selectors fit strictly within training folds; platform rejects external/global selectors

attacks.attack_name: Decision Threshold Overfitting on Test Split
attacks.expected_effect: Tuning decision boundary directly on test data inflates reported test metrics and creates post-hoc bias
attacks.control: Invariant 5.1 & 5.2: Decision threshold computed strictly on Development OOF predictions and frozen before test access

attacks.attack_name: Repeated Test Partition Peeking for Model Selection
attacks.expected_effect: Iterative model selection on test split degrades test set into a validation set, losing generalization guarantee
attacks.control: Invariant 6.1: Single Locked Test consumption per experiment; subsequent evaluations tagged TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC
